chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the Three Vessels.
chapter_note: This kephalaion is almost entirely systematic cosmological mechanism (gates, firmaments, rays, purification). The only clearly later material is the dialogue wrapper (“Once again…”, “The apostle says…”), which frames otherwise core teaching and a substantive cosmological question.

paragraphs.core_text: [Preac]h about this bit of life and light that comes from [these three] vessels that surround the universe [ ... ] life comes up [ ... ]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/dialogue frame: “⟨p.268⟩ Once again the disciples questioned our enlightener. They say:”
paragraphs.temporal_note: The opening formula is Kephalaia frame. The remaining question is a substantive cosmological prompt about extraction of light from the three vessels, matching the teaching substrate’s concerns and register.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] b[u]t should the [ ... ] ascend [ ... ] light of the rays that [ ... ] which are received, which shine and go in through these great open gates, through these doors, firmament by firmament.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution/title: “The apostle s[a]ys to them:” (a compilation-frame marker; “apostle” is not substrate vocabulary).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mechanistic cosmology (rays, gates/doors, ascent through successive firmaments) in an impersonal explanatory voice, but introduced by a later dialogue attribution.

paragraphs.core_text: For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar (?) that ex]ists there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic spatial/architectural mapping (four gates at compass points; worlds→vessels; rays extracting light) stays entirely within the cosmic system, with no institutional or citation markers.

paragraphs.core_text: From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [ ... ] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [ ... ] shall all [be cast] down.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure process-description of purification and sorting (clarified/cleansed vs. cast down; taken up with the living ones) expressed as cosmological mechanics, without frame/pastoral/NT overlay.
